thread:
nina: Need a concise play for overspill (Dedicated -> Hosted). Two concerns: billing attribution and QoS preservation.
oscar: Proposal: signed short-lived header `X-RW-Attribution` (JWT) with claims: tenant, commit_id, qos_hint, settlement_mode. Hosted validates signature and settlement_mode drives billing action.
pat: Settlement modes: `use_commit` (Redwood absorbs + ledger entry), `bill_hosted` (tenant billed per-hosted rates), `invoice_monthly` (private customers).
rachel: QoS: propagate `X-RW-QoS` and let Hosted honor it only for committed tiers. Implementation: two worker queues (priority/normal) to approximate preemption.
oscar: Security: JWT TTL minutes, nonce, signed by control plane key. Failures -> consult tenant `overspill_fail_open` flag (default reject).
legal: For on-prem/private, overspill must be opt-in written consent.
pat: Metrics: overspill_rate, overspill_tokens, overspill_cost_usd. Console alert if forecast > allowance.
nina: Action items: 1) oscar prototype JWT + key rotation 2) pat add tenant fields `overspill_mode`+`allowance` 3) rachel add Hosted queue change behind ff 4) legal publish consent text. We'll RFC when prototype traces are in. :thumbsup:
